anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.text:
gauntlet: gate=gatekeep-pr/initial recommended=1

This PR adds one bounded retry when the feed fetch fails, along with tests for it. You are the author, and the retry and its tests do what the description promises.

Merging is waiting on one thing: the required e2e check is still running on this head. The test check has already passed. Merge is not offered yet because e2e has not finished. Delivery watches it, and merge becomes available once it passes. No problems or smaller points remain.

I recommend deliver because the running e2e check is the only thing holding back merge, and delivery waits for it to finish.

Pick one:
1. deliver - watch the e2e check, rebase on main if the branch falls behind, and continue until merge is offered. [recommended]
2. assess - post nothing, because there are no problems, and end without repairs or watching.
3. stop - remove the worktree and leave the PR as it is.

Type a number; show evidence prints the full record.
